editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood taqueria dishing out fresh, well-seasoned steak tacos, oversized burritos, and house-made salsas that keep people coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the steak tacos and chorizo tacos, and don't skip the house red and green salsas—reviewers go through half a bottle. Late-night visits are a solid move for post-night-out cravings.
